goal: Prevent transaction variants with identical txids from stalling package relay and orphan resolution
Keep fee-bumping CPFP packages propagating when a peer provides an invalid parent variant
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because same-txid variants can stall package relay and delay CPFP packages until confirmation
Prevents invalid or witnessless parents from poisoning reject filters and evicting valid orphan children
